title: SOLDOKU
headline:
Make Sudoku
a shared challenge
body:
Create a room • Solve the same grid • Race the clock

Mobile-first competitive Sudoku on Solana
Available on the web and Seeker

title: WHY WE BUILT IT
headline:
Share the moment
you finish
body:
A Sudoku puzzle is usually a solo challenge
We wanted finishing it to become a shared moment

Friends solve the same grid and compare their times
Familiar rules make it easy to start
note: Built for puzzle players and friends

title: THE GAME
headline:
Your pace
Or a race
body:
CLASSIC  /  Solve at your own pace
Notes, hints, pause and resume

PRACTICE  /  Race a friend
Create a room and share the code

COMPETE  /  Climb the leaderboard
One timed attempt per wallet
note: Classic and Practice work without a wallet

title: THE PLAYER JOURNEY
headline:
Room code
to leaderboard
body:
Create or join a competition room
Authorize your wallet with a message
Start your attempt and solve the shared grid
Compare your valid finish time on the leaderboard

Free competitions need no deposit
Funded rooms add token entry and a prize pool
note: Choose a preset entry amount or set your own

title: WHY SOLANA
headline:
A prize pool
players can inspect
body:
Token deposits go into Solana escrow
The unique fastest valid finisher claims the pool
Ties or no valid finishes return entrants’ stakes

Gameplay verification and ranking run off-chain
Deposits, settlement and payouts are on-chain
note: The server verifies play and authorizes settlement  /  Wallets approve transactions

title: BUILT AND TESTED ON SEEKER
headline:
From wallet approval
to a completed claim
body:
Physical Seeker tests passed
Wallet connection, message approval and token deposits
Winner claims, refunds and wallet return

Two 1-token entries → 2-token winner claim
Refund returned 1 token → vault empty
Duplicate-payment checks passed
note: Dated receipts are public  /  Android hosted web app with Mobile Wallet Adapter

title: WHAT COMES NEXT
headline:
Bring a friend
Play another grid
body:
Classic, Practice and free competitions are available

Next: test whether players invite friends and return
Improve fair-play controls and financial reliability
